description: Cheapest live x402 providers for a task. Placement is never sold. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 at $0.005 USDC. Same resource URL as the REST route.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of results. Integer from 1 to 20. Omit to default to 10.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional numeric upper bound on a matched provider's advertised priceUsd. Must be finite and at least 0.

network.description: CAIP-2 of the live settlement network. Omit or send empty to use the configured default. A non-empty value must equal the schema enum exactly.

query.description: Search string. After trim: 1 to 200 characters. Whitespace is collapsed.

type.description: Provider transport filter. Omit or send empty to default to any. Must be http, mcp, or any.

name: find_provider
